column1: # zen* image toolkit — canonical crate registry
# Source of truth for the README crosslink footer. Edit here, then regenerate
# Groups (render order): codecs internals compression process color framework metrics ml corpora tools
# Only zen-native crates we publish appear here. Upstream forks we don't own
# are intentionally excluded — we don't inject our conventions into them.
# The repo column is the REPO the crate ships from, which is not always a repo of
# the same name (zentiff/zenpdf/zensvg/zenjp2 -> zenextras, zenyuv -> zenjpeg,
# Every repo linked here MUST be public and unarchived — a private or archived
# target 404s for readers. Re-verify with: gh api repos/imazen/<repo>.
